label_descriptions.ALDE: Alliance of Liberals and Democrats for Europe / Renew Europe — pro-EU, liberal, centrist, free-market with social safeguards, civil liberties.
label_descriptions.ECR+ID: European Conservatives and Reformists + Identity and Democracy — right-wing to far-right, national-conservative to nationalist, soft-to-hard Eurosceptic, against further EU integration, anti-immigration, traditional values.
label_descriptions.GUE/NGL: European United Left / Nordic Green Left — radical/far left, anti-austerity, anti-NATO, strong workers' rights and public ownership.
label_descriptions.Greens/EFA: Greens / European Free Alliance — environmentalism, climate action, progressive social policy, regional / minority rights.
label_descriptions.PPE: European People's Party (EPP) — centre-right Christian democrats, pro-EU, fiscally conservative, socially moderate-to-conservative.
label_descriptions.S&D: Progressive Alliance of Socialists and Democrats — centre-left social democrats, pro-EU, welfare state, workers' rights, social justice.
